summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Aya Gold & Silver Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, announcing that its common shares began trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market on May 4, 2026, under ticker 'AYA', while remaining listed on the TSX. The filing also provides Q1-2026 earnings release date and conference call details. No transaction with special-situations characteristics such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other event is described. The filing is a routine update regarding a new exchange listing and earnings schedule, not a special situation.
